dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: Rustam, I'm completely lost. I'm trying to get to the regional library but I can't find it.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Okay, where are you right now?

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: I'm at the bus stop opposite the Central Mosque. I can see a pharmacy across the street.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Perfect — I know exactly where you are. The library is about ten minutes on foot. Are you facing the mosque?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Good. Turn left and walk along the main road. Don't cross the road yet — stay on the same side as the mosque.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: After about three minutes you'll pass a large bank on your left. Just past the bank, there's a pedestrian crossing. Cross the road there.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: Got it. I can see the bank. Crossing now.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Once you're across, turn right. You'll be walking along a narrower street now. Go past a small park on your right — don't go into the park, just keep going straight.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: Okay, past the park. There's a café on the corner.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Yes — at that café, turn left. Walk through a short tunnel under the railway line. It takes about thirty seconds.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: Through the tunnel — okay. I'm in it now. Bit dark.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Once you come out of the tunnel, you'll see a large building with blue glass directly ahead. That's not the library — that's the city administration. Turn right at that building.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: Okay, turning right. I can see a sign.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: The library is at the end of that street, at the top of some steps. Go up the steps and through the main entrance.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyar
dialogue.text: I can see it! Steps and everything. Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Good. Next time, save it on your maps app.

"along" = following the length of something (a road, river, corridor).

questions.text: "Cross the road." "Cross" is used when you move:
opts: From one side to the other
questions.correct: From one side to the other
questions.hint: "cross" = move from one side to the other (crossing a road, bridge, room). ✅

questions.text: "Walk ___ a short tunnel under the railway line."
questions.hint: "through" = entering and exiting the other side of an enclosed space. "Walk THROUGH a tunnel." ✅
"past" = move beyond something without stopping. "Go PAST the bank" = walk by the bank and keep going.

questions.text: "The library is at the top of some steps." "At the top of" means:
questions.hint: "at the top of the steps" = at the highest point; when you've climbed all the steps.

questions.text: "Stay on the same side as the mosque." "On the same side as" means:
opts: Adjacent to on the same side
questions.correct: Adjacent to on the same side
questions.hint: "on the same side as" = on the identical side; don't cross — remain on this side of the road.

questions.text: "Once you come ___ of the tunnel, you'll see the building."
questions.hint: "come OUT OF" = exit an enclosed space. "Come out of the tunnel." ✅

questions.text: "Go up the steps." "Up" is used because:
opts: The steps lead to a higher level
questions.correct: The steps lead to a higher level
questions.hint: "up" = moving to a higher position. "Go UP the steps" = climb to where the steps lead.
